gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin-ha: A flat, stencil-cut look defines Bevellier, its letters set tightly together. Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau handles the quieter work, its open curves leaving room to breathe while Bevellier takes the spotlight.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin give Bevellier its flat, stencil-cut look, with letters sitting very close together. Bevellier handles display; Noto Sans PhagsPa handles the approachable, see-through text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Bevellier draws every stroke at a single weight, with no thick-thin shift, and packs its letters tightly. Then Noto Sans Sundanese settles in with open-mouthed e crossbars and capitals barely above the lowercase.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Graceful and compact, Bevellier looks bent from a single wire. Over many lines, Noto Sans Sunuwar, a plain sans, stays easy to follow, its curves leaving daylight in every bowl.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac is a plain sans with tall, bulb-like bowls. Bevellier, with strokes as constant as bent wire, gives headings a flat, stencil-cut edge that the rounder text letters soften.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-syriac-wes: Sophisticated and flat, Bevellier is built from rounded rods of single weight. Bevellier owns display lines while Noto Sans Syriac Western, a sans-serif, handles text, its terminals held far from the stroke body.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Graceful and tightly spaced, Bevellier matches its bowls and stems in weight. Beside it, Noto Sans Tagalog, a plain sans, fills the middle of each line with generous gaps in its curves.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le, a sans-serif, tapers its ink strokes before they touch and keeps capitals barely above lowercase. Bevellier brings a plain, unshaded line that never swells to the headings.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-takri: Sophisticated and graceful, Bevellier has flat, stencil-cut, tightly spaced letters whose horizontals are no thinner than its verticals. Noto Sans Takri adds a high-waisted lowercase with generously open curves beneath it.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-tc: Flat and stencil-cut, Bevellier keeps every stroke at a steady thickness. It earns its keep big and short, while Noto Sans TC, a sans-serif, lets its large counters open outward.
